name: AwesomeRepos
tagline: Facts, star trends, and Tags for GitHub repositories, over OAuth MCP.
description: AwesomeRepos is an index of GitHub repositories. Its hosted MCP server lets agents search repositories and Tags, read the facts of one repository (stars, star changes, license, releases, maintenance, dependencies), get the Trending list, and see what changed in a Tag. With account access, agents can also read the user's Bookmarks and Saved Views. The server is read-only.

methods.label: OAuth 2.0
methods.note: Needs a free AwesomeRepos account. MCP clients discover the authorization server and register themselves.

auth.guide:
**Hosted MCP with OAuth (fastest):** add the server, then sign in with a free AwesomeRepos account and allow access in the browser.

```bash
claude mcp add --transport http awesomerepos --scope user https://awesomerepos.com/mcp
```

In Claude Code, type `/mcp` and select `awesomerepos` to sign in, or run `claude mcp login awesomerepos`. A `claude -p` run cannot sign in, so sign in one time with `/mcp` first. Create the account at [awesomerepos.com/signup](https://awesomerepos.com/signup); sign-in needs a confirmed email address.

The server publishes [protected resource metadata](https://awesomerepos.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp) with two scopes. `repositories:read` covers the repository tools. `account:read` is needed only for `list_bookmarks`, `list_saved_views`, and `get_saved_view`, and for `get_tag_changes` when no Tags are given. The authorization server supports dynamic client registration, client ID metadata documents, and S256 PKCE.

**Gotchas:** the token goes only in `Authorization: Bearer {token}`; the endpoint never accepts a session cookie. Each account has limits: 30 tool calls a minute, 500 a day, and 1,500 returned repositories a day (UTC). The server is in a public test that ends on 27 December 2026.

interfaces.name: AwesomeRepos MCP
interfaces.note: Read-only. Streamable HTTP. Scopes repositories:read and account:read (Bookmarks and Saved Views). Per-account limits apply; the public test ends on 2026-12-27.
